patterns.name: Evidence-First Memory
patterns.description: Store reusable knowledge with source provenance and review state instead of relying on unsupported recollection.
patterns.agent_rule: When durable memory affects future behavior, preserve source evidence and confidence.
patterns.runtime_rule: Require source/capture identifiers for graph or skill updates.

patterns.name: Progressive Skill Disclosure
patterns.description: Expose a concise skill trigger first, then load detailed references, scripts, or assets only when needed.
patterns.agent_rule: Keep skill entrypoints small and push bulky context into references or tools.
patterns.runtime_rule: Skill installers should preserve metadata, references, and verification scripts separately.

failure_modes.name: Unsupported Memory Write
failure_modes.description: A system stores a durable lesson without enough source evidence or user/reviewer approval.
failure_modes.detection: Memory notes, graph edges, or generated skills lack source IDs, evidence IDs, or review metadata.
failure_modes.mitigation: Use capture, proposal, review, and apply steps before durable graph or skill changes.

agent_practices.name: Capture Before Graph
agent_practices.trigger: A web page, paper, repo, or local document should become durable Praxis knowledge.
agent_practices.practice: Capture the source first, then create a graph proposal, review it, and apply only supported relationships.
agent_practices.anti_pattern: Directly adding graph edges or skills from a raw web page without preserved evidence.
